body.en:
Why use compression reinforcement?

  • Restricted beam depth or width makes singly reinforced limiting moment insufficient.
  • Moment reversal can change the tension face, requiring appropriate reinforcement on both faces.
  • Compression bars can assist long-term behaviour and ductility, subject to design and detailing.

A doubly reinforced beam resists flexure through concrete compression, compression steel and tension steel. Stirrups restrain compression bars and carry shear. Providing top hanger bars alone does not mean their contribution to ultimate compression has been established.
body.gu:
Compression reinforcement ની જરૂર કેમ પડે?

  • Beam depth અથવા width પર મર્યાદા હોવાથી singly reinforced limiting moment પૂરતો ન હોય.
  • Moment reversal થી tension face બદલાય અને બંને faces પર યોગ્ય reinforcement જરૂરી બને.
  • Design અને detailing મુજબ compression bars long-term behaviour તથા ductility માં મદદ કરી શકે.

Doubly reinforced beam માં concrete compression, compression steel અને tension steel મળીને flexure resist કરે છે. Stirrups, compression bars ને restrain કરી shear પણ લે છે. માત્ર ઉપર hanger bars આપવાથી ultimate compression માં તેમનો ફાળો સાબિત થતો નથી.

h.en: 3.2 Strain compatibility and compression steel stress
h.gu: 3.2 Strain compatibility અને compression steel stress

items.syllabus_item: 3.2 stress diagram fsc d prime d

body.en:
For neutral-axis depth xu, compression steel centroid d′ from the compression face and maximum concrete strain 0.0035, the steel strain is εsc = 0.0035(xu − d′)/xu, when d′ < xu. Obtain design stress fsc at this strain from the appropriate IS 456 design stress–strain curve or SP 16 tables for the steel grade; compression steel does not always reach 0.87fy. For analysis, xu is unknown and usually found iteratively.

Use force equilibrium with the concrete stress displaced by the compression steel: T = Cc + (fsc − fcc)Asc, where fcc is the concrete stress at the steel level included in Cc. When the steel lies in the rectangular maximum-stress part of the concrete block, fcc may be taken as 0.446fck; otherwise use the actual compatible concrete stress. Do not subtract 0.446fck indiscriminately.
body.gu:
Neutral-axis depth xu, compression face થી compression steel centroid d′ અને maximum concrete strain 0.0035 હોય ત્યારે d′ < xu માટે steel strain εsc = 0.0035(xu − d′)/xu છે. આ strain માટે steel grade મુજબ યોગ્ય IS 456 design stress–strain curve અથવા SP 16 tables થી design stress fsc મેળવો; compression steel હંમેશા 0.87fy સુધી પહોંચતું નથી. Analysis માં xu અજ્ઞાત હોય છે અને સામાન્ય રીતે iteration થી મળે છે.

Compression steel એ ખસેડેલા concrete stress સાથે force equilibrium લો: T = Cc + (fsc − fcc)Asc, જ્યાં fcc એ Cc માં સમાવાયેલ steel level પરનું concrete stress છે. Steel, concrete block ના rectangular maximum-stress ભાગમાં હોય ત્યારે fcc = 0.446fck લઈ શકાય; અન્યથા compatible actual concrete stress લો. 0.446fck દરેક પરિસ્થિતિમાં અંધપણે બાદ ન કરો.

items.syllabus_item: 3.3 analysis design IS 456 SP16 table chart

body.en:
IS 456 design procedure:

  1. Choose b, d, d′, material grades and factored moment. Calculate xu,max and singly reinforced limiting moment.
  2. For Mu greater than Mlim, take the difference as additional moment. Determine fsc from the strain at xu,max and the displaced concrete stress fcc.
  3. Calculate Asc = (Mu − Mlim)/[(fsc − fcc)(d − d′)] and additional Ast2 = (Mu − Mlim)/[0.87fy(d − d′)] when tension steel satisfies design strain.
  4. Add Ast2 to limiting tension steel; choose practical bars and recalculate centroids and resistance. Check shear, deflection, anchorage, ties and detailing.

SP 16: select the correct table/chart for concrete and steel grades, section, d′/d and dimensionless moment. Read/interpolate as directed, use the correct table definitions and check reinforcement and code limits. Do not invent chart values.
body.gu:
IS 456 design procedure:

  1. b, d, d′, material grades અને factored moment પસંદ કરો. xu,max તથા singly reinforced limiting moment ગણો.
  2. Mu, Mlim કરતાં વધુ હોય તો તફાવત additional moment લો. xu,max પર strain થી fsc અને displaced concrete stress fcc શોધો.
  3. Tension steel design strain સંતોષે ત્યારે Asc = (Mu − Mlim)/[(fsc − fcc)(d − d′)] અને additional Ast2 = (Mu − Mlim)/[0.87fy(d − d′)] ગણો.
  4. Ast2 ને limiting tension steel માં ઉમેરો; વ્યવહારુ bars પસંદ કરી centroids અને resistance ફરી ગણો. Shear, deflection, anchorage, ties અને detailing તપાસો.

SP 16: concrete અને steel grades, section, d′/d તથા dimensionless moment માટે યોગ્ય table/chart પસંદ કરો. સૂચના મુજબ read/interpolate કરો, table ની ચોક્કસ definitions અને reinforcement તથા code limits તપાસો. Chart values મનથી ન લો.

title.gu: Doubly reinforced beam section ની આકૃતિ

title.en: Numerical 3.1 — Design steel for moment above limiting capacity
title.gu: Numerical 3.1 — Limiting capacity કરતાં વધુ moment માટે steel design

body.en:
Given: For a rectangular beam, b = 250 mm, d = 450 mm, d′ = 45 mm, fck = 20 MPa, fy = 415 MPa and Mu = 180 kN m. At the limiting strain assume conservative design stress fsc = 351.8 MPa; compression steel is in the rectangular stress-block zone, so fcc = 0.446fck. Find theoretical steel areas.

Step 1. Find the limiting neutral axis and moment.

xu,max = 0.48dxu,max = 0.48 × 450xu,max = 216 mmMlim = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × 216 × (450 − 0.42 × 216) / 10⁶Mlim ≈ 139.69 kN m

Step 2. Check compression strain and calculate the extra moment.

εsc = 0.0035(xu,max − d′) / xu,maxεsc = 0.0035(216 − 45) / 216εsc ≈ 0.002771M2 = 180 − 139.688M2 = 40.312 kN mfcc = 0.446 × 20fcc = 8.92 MPa

Step 3. Calculate compression and additional tension steel.

Asc = M2 / [(fsc − fcc)(d − d′)]Asc = 40.312 × 10⁶ / [(351.8 − 8.92)(450 − 45)]Asc ≈ 290.29 mm²Ast2 = M2 / [0.87fy(d − d′)]Ast2 = 40.312 × 10⁶ / [0.87 × 415 × 405]Ast2 ≈ 275.68 mm²

Step 4. Calculate limiting tension steel and total.

Ast1 = 0.36fck b xu,max / (0.87fy)Ast1 = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × 216 / (0.87 × 415)Ast1 ≈ 1076.86 mm²Ast = Ast1 + Ast2Ast ≈ 1076.86 + 275.68

Final answer:

Theoretical Ast ≈ 1352.54 mm² and Asc ≈ 290.29 mm²; select bars and complete all checks.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Rectangular beam માટે b = 250 mm, d = 450 mm, d′ = 45 mm, fck = 20 MPa, fy = 415 MPa અને Mu = 180 kN m છે. Limiting strain પર conservative design stress fsc = 351.8 MPa ધારો; compression steel rectangular stress-block zone માં હોવાથી fcc = 0.446fck છે. Theoretical steel areas શોધો.

Step 1. Limiting neutral axis અને moment શોધો.

xu,max = 0.48dxu,max = 0.48 × 450xu,max = 216 mmMlim = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × 216 × (450 − 0.42 × 216) / 10⁶Mlim ≈ 139.69 kN m

Step 2. Compression strain તપાસી extra moment ગણો.

εsc = 0.0035(xu,max − d′) / xu,maxεsc = 0.0035(216 − 45) / 216εsc ≈ 0.002771M2 = 180 − 139.688M2 = 40.312 kN mfcc = 0.446 × 20fcc = 8.92 MPa

Step 3. Compression અને additional tension steel ગણો.

Asc = M2 / [(fsc − fcc)(d − d′)]Asc = 40.312 × 10⁶ / [(351.8 − 8.92)(450 − 45)]Asc ≈ 290.29 mm²Ast2 = M2 / [0.87fy(d − d′)]Ast2 = 40.312 × 10⁶ / [0.87 × 415 × 405]Ast2 ≈ 275.68 mm²

Step 4. Limiting tension steel અને કુલ steel ગણો.

Ast1 = 0.36fck b xu,max / (0.87fy)Ast1 = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × 216 / (0.87 × 415)Ast1 ≈ 1076.86 mm²Ast = Ast1 + Ast2Ast ≈ 1076.86 + 275.68

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Theoretical Ast ≈ 1352.54 mm² અને Asc ≈ 290.29 mm²; bars પસંદ કરી બધા checks પૂર્ણ કરો.

body.en:
Given: A rectangular M20/Fe415 section has b = 250 mm, d = 450 mm, d′ = 40 mm, Ast = 1377.405 mm² and Asc = 400 mm². A trial neutral axis xu = 200 mm gives compatible design compression-steel stress fsc = 352.2 MPa from the assumed design curve. Check equilibrium and determine moment.

Step 1. Check strain, concrete stress and tension steel condition.

εsc = 0.0035(xu − d′) / xuεsc = 0.0035(200 − 40) / 200εsc = 0.0028fcc = 0.446 × 20fcc = 8.92 MPaxu,max = 0.48 × 450xu,max = 216 mmxu = 200 mm < xu,max

Step 2. Check force equilibrium using the supplied stress.

T = 0.87 × 415 × 1377.405T ≈ 497312 NCc = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × 200Cc = 360000 NCs,net = (352.2 − 8.92) × 400Cs,net = 137312 NCc + Cs,net = 497312 N

Step 3. Take moments of compression forces about tensile steel.

Mu = Cc(d − 0.42xu) + Cs,net(d − d′)Mu = 360000 × (450 − 0.42 × 200) + 137312 × (450 − 40)Mu ≈ 188.06 × 10⁶ N mm

Final answer:

Moment resistance ≈ 188.06 kN m for the supplied curve stress and assumed trial axis; complete other checks.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Rectangular M20/Fe415 section માટે b = 250 mm, d = 450 mm, d′ = 40 mm, Ast = 1377.405 mm² અને Asc = 400 mm² છે. Trial neutral axis xu = 200 mm પર ધારેલ design curve મુજબ compatible compression-steel stress fsc = 352.2 MPa મળે છે. Equilibrium તપાસી moment શોધો.

Step 1. Strain, concrete stress અને tension steel condition તપાસો.

εsc = 0.0035(xu − d′) / xuεsc = 0.0035(200 − 40) / 200εsc = 0.0028fcc = 0.446 × 20fcc = 8.92 MPaxu,max = 0.48 × 450xu,max = 216 mmxu = 200 mm < xu,max

Step 2. આપેલ stress થી force equilibrium તપાસો.

T = 0.87 × 415 × 1377.405T ≈ 497312 NCc = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × 200Cc = 360000 NCs,net = (352.2 − 8.92) × 400Cs,net = 137312 NCc + Cs,net = 497312 N

Step 3. Tensile steel વિશે compression forces ના moments લો.

Mu = Cc(d − 0.42xu) + Cs,net(d − d′)Mu = 360000 × (450 − 0.42 × 200) + 137312 × (450 − 40)Mu ≈ 188.06 × 10⁶ N mm

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આપેલ curve stress અને ધારેલ trial axis માટે moment resistance ≈ 188.06 kN m; અન્ય checks પૂર્ણ કરો.

q.en: When is doubly reinforced design useful?
q.gu: Doubly reinforced design ક્યારે ઉપયોગી છે?

a.en: When depth is limited and limiting singly reinforced moment is insufficient.
a.gu: Depth મર્યાદિત હોય અને singly reinforced limiting moment પૂરતો ન હોય ત્યારે.

q.en: Where is compression steel for sagging moment?
q.gu: Sagging moment માટે compression steel ક્યાં હોય છે?

a.en: Distance from compression face to compression steel centroid.
a.gu: Compression face થી compression steel centroid સુધીનું અંતર.

q.gu: fsc શું છે?

a.en: Design stress in compression steel at compatible strain.
a.gu: Compatible strain પર compression steel નો design stress.

q.gu: Compression steel હંમેશા yield થાય છે?

a.en: No; determine its stress from its strain.
a.gu: નહીં; strain પરથી તેનો stress શોધો.

q.gu: Displaced concrete stress શું છે?

a.en: Concrete stress at the steel location already counted in the concrete block.
a.gu: Steel location પર concrete block માં પહેલેથી ગણાયેલ concrete stress.

q.gu: Displaced concrete કેમ બાદ કરીએ?

a.en: To avoid counting the same area twice.
a.gu: એક જ area બે વાર ન ગણાય તે માટે.

q.gu: Mlim શું છે?

a.gu: Singly reinforced flexure નો limiting moment.

q.gu: Additional moment કોણ resist કરે છે?

a.en: A couple of added tension and net compression-steel forces.
a.gu: Added tension અને net compression-steel forces નું couple.

q.gu: SP 16 શું આપે છે?

a.en: Design aids including tables and charts.
a.gu: Tables અને charts સહિત design aids.

q.en: Why recalculate effective depth after bar selection?
q.gu: Bars પસંદ કર્યા પછી effective depth ફરી કેમ ગણવી?
Shear checks હજુ જરૂરી છે?

a.en: Yes; flexural design alone is incomplete.
a.gu: હા; ફક્ત flexural design અધૂરું છે.

q.en: Explain the need for and behaviour of doubly reinforced beams.
q.gu: Doubly reinforced beams ની જરૂરિયાત અને behaviour સમજાવો.

q.en: Design a doubly reinforced rectangular beam using IS 456 for given data.
q.gu: આપેલ data માટે IS 456 વડે doubly reinforced rectangular beam design કરો.

q.en: Analyse a doubly reinforced section using strain compatibility.
q.gu: Strain compatibility વડે doubly reinforced section નું analysis કરો.

q.en: Describe the use of SP 16 tables and charts for a doubly reinforced section.
q.gu: Doubly reinforced section માટે SP 16 tables અને charts નો ઉપયોગ સમજાવો.

q.en: Define compression steel stress and strain.
q.gu: Compression steel stress અને strain વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો.
Displaced concrete stress કેમ બાદ કરીએ?
d′/d ની અસર સમજાવો.
Reinforcement પસંદ કર્યા પછીના checks લખો.
